implementation.function: Hardware controls atomic broker/collector admission, accepted-row identities and completeness, producer completion, committed projection routing, finish and collector/window reset.
implementation.declared_state_scope: Source-declared register widths, not a synthesis or physical-area measurement.
implementation.data_path: The existing compiled-memory32-head broker, context handoff and projection read window are unchanged. All raw context data travels through their actual ready/valid ports.
implementation.source_binding: Public control and unit test are byte-identical to executed native inputs. Trained test differs only in its top-module name and six fixture paths resolving to the same private inputs from the project root.
implementation.fixture_scope: Captured vectors and compiler models remain private under .cache; they are required to rerun the trained test.

lifecycle.admission: Admit broker and collector atomically; require all32heads and a query fitting the existing11-bit collector contract. Capture query,epoch,tag.
lifecycle.archive_witness: Require all_contexts_collected until the first accepted row. Its accepted-head mask retains that proof while the broker releases archives. Identity and duplicate checks apply to every row.
lifecycle.committed_frame: All32matching rows, successful broker completion, and converted collector context are required before new projection commands.
lifecycle.finish_priority: A pending finish suppresses new-command admission. Committed context routing stays attached while accepted projection commands and bus traffic drain.
lifecycle.failures: Cancel is driven from registered Abort state to avoid valid/cancel feedback. Drain the broker and wait for projection idle, reset collector/window, then hold failed completion and reset-required until global reset.
lifecycle.invalid_configuration: Reject without partially admitting either child; wait for projection idle before resetting the attached window.
lifecycle.positive_reuse: Collector release and query completion are hardware-controlled. Successful completion holds until acknowledgement, then permits another query without reset.
lifecycle.external_idle_contract: projection_idle must include command completion and transport idle; metadata clients must honor the existing block/rebuild contract.

native_unit_controls.peer_behavior: Models archive-complete withdrawal after first row acceptance and row-valid withdrawal on cancellation.
native_unit_controls.expected_timeout_scope: Cancellation-feedback counterexample exited124 at its30-second bound and retained rawNCTERM diagnostics. It is a rejected counterexample, not a passing functional run.

native_trained_result.memory_witness_scope: 600 core/aggregate-family macro witnesses plus6 existing collector memories; not a full-chip memory inventory.
native_trained_result.source_operands: The prior captured projected cache and fixed-scale integer reference; no fresh hardware projection is claimed for this test.
